subject: Game Theory
title: Ad Auctions
description: A fast breakdown of Ad Auctions for builders.

hook.text: Every Google search triggers an auction among advertisers in milliseconds. Billions of auctions run daily, invisibly.

buildup.text: Google's ad auction ranks ads by bid × quality score. The highest rank wins the top spot and pays per click.

discovery.text: It uses a generalized second-price model: each advertiser pays just enough to beat the next one's effective bid.

twist.text: Quality score rewards relevance: a lower bid with a better ad can beat a higher bid. This improves user experience.

climax.text: Hal Varian, Google's chief economist, designed this system. It generates over $200 billion yearly in ad revenue.

punchline.text: Every search funds the internet via auctions.

quiz.question: What determines ad ranking in Google's auction?
